taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Kubernetes Secret storage encryption and effective read paths
controls.source_trace: Separate base64 representation, encryption at rest and API authorization. Trace access to plaintext through datastore backups, providers and permitted API readers.
controls.implementation_branch: API authorization, etcd encryption and node/workload delivery protect different paths. A base64 field is not encryption, while a privileged API reader obtaining plaintext may be expected. Verify encryption-provider ordering, rotation/rewrite status and storage evidence without publishing real keys; configured encryption alone does not prove historical objects were rewritten.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local cluster/synthetic Secret and an owned storage snapshot to distinguish plaintext persistence from authorized API decryption.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Reading a Secret through an authorized API is expected even when at-rest encryption works; base64 alone is not encryption evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Protect storage/backups and effective read authority, verifying key rotation, rewrite and recovery behavior.
